sections.st: PCB & Circuit Board Packaging Manufacturer India — ESD-Safe Antistatic PCB Trays, Bulk from Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures PCB and circuit board packaging from our ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom ESD-safe antistatic thermoformed trays for bare PCBs, assembled circuit boards, and mixed-technology boards. Bulk PCB packaging trays from Vapi for PCB manufacturers, EMS companies, electronics OEMs, and PCB distributors across India and for export. As a PCB circuit board packaging manufacturer from India, we supply ESD-safe antistatic packaging for domestic electronics manufacturing and export PCB supply chains.

PCB packaging has two critical design dimensions that no other electronics packaging application requires simultaneously: gold finger protection and component height clearance. Gold fingers (exposed edge connector pads at the PCB perimeter used for PCB-to-PCB connection) must not contact any packaging material — contamination or mechanical damage to gold finger pads causes connector failure. Component height — the maximum height of any component on the assembled PCB — determines the minimum cavity height the packaging must provide without component contact.

sections.st: Three Problems PCB & Circuit Board Packaging Buyers Face

strips.title: Gold Finger Contamination — Connector Failure at System Assembly
strips.desc: Problem: Gold finger edge connectors contaminated by packaging material contact (oil from PP, particulates from cavity wall) cause contact resistance failures at system assembly — the PCB edge connector does not make reliable electrical contact with the system connector. Solution: Gold finger clearance cavity — the edge connector area of the PCB is suspended in a defined clearance zone with no packaging contact on gold finger surfaces.

strips.title: ESD Damage to Assembled PCB Components
strips.desc: Problem: Assembled PCBs with populated components are highly ESD-sensitive — a single ESD event through a component lead can permanently damage the entire PCB assembly. Non-ESD-safe packaging in the PCB supply chain is one of the primary sources of latent PCB damage. Solution: ESD-safe PP trays for all assembled PCB packaging — charge dissipation throughout the supply chain, CoA per batch.

strips.title: Component Height Mismatch — Components Contact Cavity Ceiling
strips.desc: Problem: Assembled PCBs where the tallest component height has not been accounted for in the packaging cavity height — the component contacts the cavity ceiling under stack load, causing component deformation. Solution: Maximum component height confirmed from PCB assembly specification or physical board measurement before cavity design.

sections.st: PCB & Circuit Board Packaging — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Gold Finger Clearance Zone — No Packaging Contact on Edge Connector
strips.desc: The gold finger edge connector area (typically 2–5mm at the PCB perimeter) is mapped from the PCB specification before cavity design. The cavity provides a defined clearance zone over the gold finger area — no packaging material contact with the gold finger surface. Clearance width confirmed from the edge connector specification.

strips.title: Component Height Survey — Maximum Component Clearance
strips.desc: All assembled PCB packaging includes a component height survey — the maximum height of any component on the populated board is confirmed from the PCB assembly drawing or physical board measurement. Cavity height designed to provide minimum 2mm clearance above the maximum component height under full stack load.

strips.title: ESD-Safe PP Throughout — Bare Board and Assembled Board
strips.desc: ESD-safe PP for both bare PCB packaging (PCB substrate is ESD-sensitive) and assembled PCB packaging (populated components are ESD-sensitive). Surface resistivity CoA per batch for all PCB packaging production runs.

strips.title: PCB Warp Prevention — Flat Geometry Maintenance
strips.desc: PCBs (particularly large-format PCBs) must be maintained flat during transit — pallet stack load on improperly supported PCBs causes permanent warp. Cavity design provides full PCB footprint support at the base — no edge-only support that allows PCB centre sag under load.

faqs.q: What is gold finger protection in PCB packaging?
faqs.a: Gold fingers are exposed edge connector pads at the PCB perimeter. Gold finger contamination from packaging material contact causes contact resistance failures. Gold finger clearance zone in the cavity — no packaging material contact with the gold finger surface. Clearance confirmed from PCB specification before tooling.

faqs.q: What is the component height survey for assembled PCBs?
faqs.a: Maximum height of any populated component confirmed from PCB assembly drawing or physical measurement. Cavity height designed for minimum 2mm clearance above maximum component height under pallet stack load.

faqs.q: Why ESD-safe PP for both bare and assembled PCB packaging?
faqs.a: Bare PCB substrate is ESD-sensitive. Assembled PCB populated components are ESD-sensitive. ESD-safe PP for both applications — CoA per batch confirms dissipative range.
